summary: Kimbell Royalty Partners, LP completed the acquisition of mineral, royalty, and related interests from Rivercrest Capital Partners LP, Rivercrest Capital Partners II LP, and Cupola Royalty Direct, LLC under a Purchase and Sale Agreement dated effective June 1, 2026, closing August 21, 2026. Consideration totaled approximately $75 million in cash plus 9.5 million OpCo common units and equal Class B units, exchangeable for Kimbell common units. A registration rights agreement obligates Kimbell to file a shelf registration for resale within 5 business days and use best efforts to make it effective within 120 days. Watch for regulatory approvals and post-closing adjustments.
